claims.claim: The headlight is a Hyundai or Kia genuine spare part.
claims.evidence: Faint lettering across the lower lens cannot be confidently read as a brand or model.

claims.claim: All Hyundai and Kia genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used.
claims.evidence: The report shows only one headlight, not the seller's inventory or shop.

risks.risk: Bulbs and electrical connections may not work.
risks.proof: Video of the headlight powered on showing low beam, high beam, and indicator illumination.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or without functional bulbs.

risks.risk: Fitment to a specific vehicle make, model, and year is unknown.
risks.proof: Clear photo of part number, brand marking, or fitment label, or a compatibility listing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown fitment that may not fit the buyer's vehicle.

risks.risk: It may be the wrong side (left or right) for the buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: Photo showing mounting bracket orientation and indicator position relative to the vehicle side.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the wrong side unless it matches the buyer's car.

risks.risk: Mounting clips and adjusters may be broken or missing.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rear mounting points, clips, and adjusters.

risks.risk: Bulbs may not be included with the unit.
risks.proof: Photo showing bulbs installed in the housings or included with the headlight.

proof_requests: Video of the headlight connected to power with all lights functioning.
Clear photo of any part number, brand marking, or lens code.
Photo showing the rear mounting brackets, clips, and adjusters.
Confirmation of left or right side and whether bulbs are included.
response.reason: The witness identifies a used car headlight, so a worst-case price is possible despite unknown fitment, untested electrics, and unreadable branding.
